Chapter 948: Chapter 11: The Goodwill Of The Robber Clan (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 948: Chapter 11: The Goodwill of the Robber Clan (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

…

After learning that Lin Yuan is the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, even Xia Qin, the Supreme, no longer insisted on Lin Yuan’s true body visiting the Central Star Domain.

In terms of safety, the ancestral homeland, the sanctuary of human civilization, is certainly not as secure as the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

During the most intense battles in history between human civilization and other pinnacle races, many ancestral lands were conquered, and the Central Star Domain became a battlefield.

But the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?

To date, it remains untouched, no matter how the alien races of the Twelfth Layer have probed, they’ve all come back empty-handed.

Lin Yuan’s true body is in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which is definitely much safer than any location in human civilization.

However, in the end, Xia Qin, the Supreme, still reminded Lin Yuan to be cautious. Those alien races of the Twelfth Layer might not make a move.

After all, Lin Yuan has already fully grown, and with the protection of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm…

Xia Qin, the Supreme, couldn’t think of any way to deal with Lin Yuan.

But if those alien races of the Twelfth Layer do make a move, it is certainly with great confidence, and that is the most dangerous.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

A figure appeared silently outside the main star.

“This is the main star of the Galaxy Master?” The figure, shrouded in a black robe, did not emit a single breath and simply watched the planet below quietly.

“Let’s go see the Galaxy Master.” Remembering the mission, the figure in the black robe immediately used the Star Platform to enter the Milky Way Main Star.

Now, the Milky Way Main Star has become the core of several dozen nearby Star Alliance territories, with vast numbers of citizens from human civilization and different alien races coming and going every day.

The figure in the black robe had proper paperwork and a legitimate identity, encountering no obstructions.

Before long.

The figure in the black robe descended upon the Milky Way Main Star and soon approached the Star Lord’s Great Hall at the center of the main star.

Star Lord’s Great Hall.

“Master, members of the Robber Clan want to see you,” reported Hongpi and another Eighth Layer alien with green eyes.

“The Robber Clan?”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, slightly puzzled.

The Robber Clan is the most mysterious among the twelve pinnacle powers of the races and possess the strongest deterrent. After all, with two beings from the Path Splitting Realm at their peak, they’re enough to make the scalps of the other eleven pinnacle races tingle with fear.

Even if these two ultimate beings from the Path Splitting Realm cannot act normally, they are still at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm; who knows what means they might have.

It is for this reason.

Among the twelve pinnacle powers in the universe, the position of the Robber Clan is the most transcendent.

“Interesting.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, “Let him in.”

Soon.

The figure in the black robe entered the Star Lord’s Great Hall.

“Greetings to the Galaxy Master,” said the figure in the black robe with great respect, bowing to Lin Yuan.

As he spoke, the figure in the black robe carefully stole a glance at Lin Yuan and noticed a young man sitting cross-legged in the distance,

At that moment, the young man was holding an ethereal book. The book was hazy, and there seemed to be a force shielding it.

Just looking at the book itself made the figure in the black robe tremble within.

“Is this the Galaxy Master?” The figure in the black robe felt nervous. Though an Eleventh Layer entity from the Robber Clan, facing Lin Yuan, also an Eleventh Layer being, he strangely felt like he was facing the ultimate ancestor of his own clan.

“What business does the Robber Clan have sending you sneaking over here?” Lin Yuan’s ethereal book dissipated, and he glanced at the black robe the figure was wearing.

This black robe was a rare piece of space-time treasure capable of insulating any aura, invisible even to ultimate entities of the Twelfth Layer unless they observed very closely.

Lin Yuan, with his Seventh Realm understanding of space-time, saw through the use of the black robe and was curious about the figure’s covert arrival.

The fact that he came with such caution, he definitely did not want others to know; probably even the supreme beings of human civilization were unaware that an Eleventh Layer entity from the Robber Clan had come to the Milky Way Main Star.

“To answer the Galaxy Master, the ancestor sent me here to tell you something,” the figure in the black robe steadied himself and spoke rapidly: “The Tianyu Clan, Insect Race, Prison Tribe, and other Twelfth Layer entities plan to join forces using that strange blood to act against you, Galaxy Master…”

“Strange blood?”

A thought crossed Lin Yuan’s mind, immediately linking it to the mysterious creature that fell into the cosmos from its inception.

This was an incident not involved with the supreme beings of human civilization, as human civilization hadn’t been born at that time. They only knew of the dreadfulness of that mysterious creature through some records.

“The Myriad Transformation Queen of the Insect Race has obtained a drop of blood from that bizarre creature?” Lin Yuan mused thoughtfully.

“Indeed,” the figure in the black robe said, “That drop of bizarre blood is the source of chaotic contamination, and lethal to any being below the twelfth layer.”

“The Galaxy Master must be extremely careful.”

The figure in the black robe immediately added.

He then laid out the entire plan of the twelfth layer beings from different races.

There might be variations, but the core point—the drop of bizarre blood—remains unchanged, and it is one of the few treasures that can affect the true form of the Galaxy Master.

Lin Yuan listened quietly.

In fact, he was not worried at all.

The beings from the Insect Race and other races at the twelfth layer believed that the drop of bizarre blood could counter Lin Yuan, based on the strength he had shown on the colossal battlefield.

But now?

After his trip to the Immortal Realm, Lin Yuan’s strength had improved so much that it was no less than a normal ultimate twelfth layer being.

More precisely, after obtaining the treasure of ‘Cang Weiyang,’ a peak existence in the Dominator Realm, Lin Yuan’s combat power would likely exceed the ordinary ultimate twelfth layer being, approaching the level of the Myriad Transformation Queen and the Xuanyuan Supreme.

That drop of blood from the bizarre creature was indeed terrifying, but it clearly could not deal with a twelfth layer being; otherwise, the Myriad Transformation Queen would not have kept it unused all these years.

The key issue is that to unleash the effect of that drop of bizarre blood, one must completely suppress a certain incarnated division of Lin Yuan, but this is absolutely impossible.

With Lin Yuan’s current mental will and soul strength, even a Dominator Realm powerhouse cannot suppress him so quickly and thoroughly without allowing him any chance to react.

“Why does your Robber Clan want to tell me this?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts spread out, and finally, he glanced at the figure in the black robe.

Lin Yuan himself knew his capabilities, but why would the Robber Clan reveal this secret willingly?

“Our ancestor did not say,” the figure in the black robe spoke softly.

He was also puzzled as to why the ancestor asked him to come here, but in the Robber Clan, the ancestor’s word was law—anything the ancestor said had to be obeyed.

“Understood,” Lin Yuan waved his hand.

The figure in the black robe immediately retreated.

…

“It seems I can no longer stay on the Milky Way Main Star,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Although the scheming of the twelfth layer beings from different races posed no threat to Lin Yuan,

if a group of ultimate twelfth layer beings were really to join forces and attack, the collateral damages from the battle would pose no problem to Lin Yuan himself, but what about the Milky Way Main Star? And the surrounding Life Planets? Their fate would surely be dire.

The fighting between ultimate twelfth layer beings could result in destruction on a galactic scale.

Naturally, Lin Yuan had to consider the countless citizens on the Milky Way Main Star.

“The beings from different races at the twelfth layer will use causality to locate my position, but if my Primordial Spirit’s incarnations are not on the Milky Way Main Star, they won’t target it specifically,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

He cares about the countless citizens on the main star, but the beings from the other races at the twelfth layer do not.

And human civilization has its supreme beings as well, if the beings from different races slaughter a Star Domain today, tomorrow they may face retaliation tenfold from the supreme beings of human civilization.

“Next, my two Primordial Spirits and many incarnations will move mostly within the Desolate Star Domain,” Lin Yuan decided in his mind.

Of course, during this time, Lin Yuan will use rule perception to conceal the causality of his incarnations.

With his current understanding of rules, even ultimate twelfth layer beings would have a hard time pinning down his exact location.

As for hiding all of his Primordial Spirit’s incarnations in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm? Although the Xuanhuang Secret Realm could isolate causality and space-time, one also cannot sense rule fluctuations within it.

Lin Yuan is naturally unwilling to contact the other twelfth layer beings, but that doesn’t mean he’s afraid of them.

“With the speed of transformation of the world within me, I will reach the pinnacle in at most a hundred years, and then I can strive for the ultimate,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If, within a hundred years, those beings from the other races fortuitously find one of Lin Yuan’s incarnations through their causal connection,

Then Lin Yuan doesn’t mind playing along with them.

If they fail to lock onto him, after a hundred years, Lin Yuan will directly attempt to reach ultimate power and step into the twelfth layer.
